set.body:
Carried over from bd-01M5MVX6JJ9RXEYT3S29Q82R58 (landed at 9252b8129):
1. ProperName folds by lowercasing and whitespace only: no Unicode normalization (NFC/NFD) and no partial names ("Ana" vs "Ana Smith"); DifferentNames then licenses a sufficient distinctness. Decide a portable normalization (JVM/JS/Native) and whether DifferentNames needs a stronger name model. Names are caller-asserted and not tied to the support.
2. Deixis counts mentions, not referents, and assumes the context lists everyone present. S3c must state detection completeness before deixis is admitted.
3. The bundle check's effect on deixis has no witness: add a borrowed-axis visual mention at the same time that is not counted present, and a cross-bundle utterance refused as nobody depicted.
4. The interval-shift digest test collides only when both counts are removed; say so in its comment.
set.title: [evidence-binding S3a remaining] Name normalization, deixis completeness and witnesses
